ETH.note: National Bank of Ethiopia is named as a partner but no mandate, licensing or oversight is stated.
No consumer-protection rule or redress stated.
Only payments to government are described.
The 46pc access figure names no survey and is not an account share.

facts.fact: Addis Fortune reports that Telebirr reached its 40-millionth user in March 2026 and that mobile-money accounts exceeded 128.5 million by December 2024.

Addis Fortune reports Ethiopia has begun piloting a Unified Government Payment Platform in the health sector for citizens to pay public services, including facility payments and health insurance premiums, with about 16 institutions in the pipeline and wider rollout targeted for 2029, per UNDP project lead Desta Bayissa.
